question: To which classes of mantras does the prescribed method apply?
premises: The method applies to Kṛṣṇa mantras.
The method applies to Rāma mantras.
The method applies to excellent incarnation mantras.
inference: The prescribed method applies in Kṛṣṇa mantras, in Rāma mantras, and in excellent incarnation mantras.
plain_english: In Kṛṣṇa mantras, in Rāma mantras, and in excellent incarnation mantras.
